text: 企查查APP显示，近日，威海矩侨工业科技有限公司发生工商变更，新增蚂蚁科技集团股份有限公司全资子公司上海云玚企业管理咨询有限公司等为股东，同时注册资本增至828.87万元。企查查信息显示，该公司成立于2023年，经营范围包含：企业总部管理；电子专用材料研发；电子专用材料销售；电子专用材料制造等。公开信息显示，该公司专注于柔性纤维传感器与织物电子皮肤研发。
text_en: Qichacha APP shows that Weihai Juqiao Industrial Technology Co., Ltd. recently underwent industrial and commercial registration changes, with Shanghai Yunyang Enterprise Management Consulting Co., Ltd., a wholly owned subsidiary of Ant Technology Group Co., Ltd., among others added as shareholders, while registered capital increased to RMB 8.2887 million. Qichacha information shows that the company was established in 2023, and its business scope includes: corporate headquarters management; R&D of special electronic materials; sales of special electronic materials; manufacturing of special electronic materials, etc. Public information shows that the company focuses on the R&D of flexible fiber sensors and textile electronic skin.
